blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — For Caitlin Viray, coming back home to Choco Mucho was one thing. Finding her rhythm again after two years away was another. After spending three seasons with Choco Mucho, Viray moved to Farm Fresh, where she played throughout 2024 and 2025. Her return to the Flying Titans in early 2026 reunited her with coach Dante Alinsunurin and University of Santo Tomas teammates during the blockbuster signing of Eya Laure to start the year.
